abilities.name: Healing Word
abilities.description: Heal an ally within 6 squares with a quick prayer.

abilities.name: Cure Wounds
abilities.description: Deliver a stronger heal to yourself or an adjacent ally.

abilities.name: Goodberry
abilities.description: Feed an adjacent ally a nourishing magic berry.

abilities.name: Nature's Mend
abilities.description: Send restorative roots and green light to a wounded ally.

abilities.name: Speak with Animals
abilities.description: Communicate with nearby beasts and learn what they have seen.

abilities.name: Song of Rest
abilities.description: Play a restorative melody that heals an ally within 4 squares.

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.description: Give an ally an inspiration die to add to a future roll.

abilities.name: Prayer of Mending
abilities.description: Send a pulse of light to restore an ally at range.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.description: Wrap an ally in a protective blessing that discourages attacks against them.

abilities.name: Healing Surge
abilities.description: Call a rush of restorative water into a wounded ally.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.description: Heal one ally; the spell may leap to another nearby wounded ally.

abilities.name: Healing Totem
abilities.description: Plant a spirit totem that supports nearby allies with steady healing.

abilities.name: Soothing Mist
abilities.description: Guide a ribbon of mist to soothe and heal an ally.

abilities.name: Renewing Wave
abilities.description: Send a quick wave of chi to a distant ally.

abilities.name: Serene Focus
abilities.description: Center your breathing and improve your defense against the next attack.

abilities.name: Flash of Light
abilities.description: Quickly restore an ally with a burst of holy light.

abilities.name: Beacon of Grace
abilities.description: Bless an ally; your next healing ability on them restores a little extra health.

abilities.name: Restorative Draught
abilities.description: Toss an ally a potent healing mixture.

abilities.name: Antidote
abilities.description: Treat an adjacent ally with an antidote and medicinal salve.

abilities.name: Volatile Flask
abilities.description: Hurl a flask that bursts in a cloud of stinging alchemical fumes.

abilities.name: Celestial Balm
abilities.description: Call down a gentle starbeam to restore an ally.

abilities.name: Warding Rune
abilities.description: Place a glowing rune that shields an ally from the next harmful strike.

abilities.name: Foresight
abilities.description: Read a flicker of possible futures and grant an ally a bonus on their next roll.

abilities.name: Ancestral Call
abilities.description: Ask a friendly ancestor spirit to mend a distant ally.

abilities.name: Spirit Tether
abilities.description: Link your spirit to an ally, sharing a little vitality with them.

abilities.name: Veil Step
abilities.description: Slip briefly through the spirit veil to reposition safely.
